scope: Selection and adjacent-thickness log-linear bracket arithmetic from unchanged archived endpoints. All continuation cases excluded from primary cohort; S0 is a separate reference. No grid/time convergence, thermophysical validity, corrected simulation or extrapolated threshold is established. Reporting domain is 1.57–157 m and 1e-19–1e-15 m²; guard points are retained for traceability. This script does not regenerate interpolated figures or read large spatial outputs.
